spec.title: Every frame placed in the world
spec.input: the tracker’s population each frame against the landmark map, by feature id
spec.expected: a pose per frame whose reprojection error is inside v3 §33’s band
spec.passCriteria: >= 60 localized frames; median reprojection error <= 2 px
spec.failureCondition: a median outside the band, or no frame localized

testResults.reason: each frame’s camera is placed against the map with a reprojection error inside the band

spec.title: Held-out prediction
spec.input: the pose re-solved on half the landmark ids, projecting the other half
spec.expected: the held-out half lands where the tracker sees it
spec.failureCondition: a pose that fits what it was solved from and predicts nothing else

testResults.observed: held-out median 0.6057 px (worst 1.6445 px) over 45 measurements
testResults.reason: the pose predicts landmarks it was not solved from

spec.title: Agrees with the map’s own registration
spec.input: on frames where the map registered a keyframe, that registration’s pose beside this frame’s solved pose
spec.expected: two independent routes to the same camera agree
spec.passCriteria: >= 5 comparisons; median rotation <= 2°; median centre <= 0.05 of a depth
spec.failureCondition: a frame pose that disagrees with the keyframe pose the map computed for the same view

testResults.observed: median 0.6472° and 0.00984 of a depth over 25 keyframes
testResults.reason: the frame pose and the map registration agree

spec.title: READY only while it is true
spec.input: the world’s state each frame, checked from outside against its four conditions
spec.expected: READY reached, and never held while tracking, gravity, ground or pose was missing
spec.passCriteria: >= 30 READY frames; 0 frames READY with a condition false
spec.failureCondition: WORLD READY without the data behind it (Rule 002)

testResults.reason: READY was a conjunction of measurements on every frame it was claimed

spec.title: Integrity and bounds
spec.input: every ingest into the world, and its bounded structures
spec.expected: nothing non-finite admitted; history and landmarks within their bounds; coverage moving only with the map
spec.passCriteria: 0 integrity issues; history <= 240; landmarks <= 5000; 0 coverage changes without a map change; every §25 field present
spec.failureCondition: a NaN in the source of truth, an unbounded structure, or coverage that grows with time

testResults.observed: 32 snapshots; history max 178; landmarks max 668; coverage 109
testResults.reason: the world stayed finite, bounded and time-independent

spec.title: Localization cost
spec.expected: small beside the rest of the frame budget

spec.title: One epoch at a time
spec.input: the surfaces in the current view, against the landmarks of the current view
spec.expected: no surface left over from a world that was redefined
spec.passCriteria: every surface’s landmarks are in the current map
spec.failureCondition: a surface from an earlier epoch served in this one’s coordinates

testResults.reason: everything served belongs to the current epoch

controller.note: Every decision carries the median worker latency and the budget it was compared against. The controller reads no clock of its own — only the timestamps on the samples it is given (§59).

segmentLog.note: The timeline is cut wherever load injection was switched on or off. FRAME-001 reads the longest unstressed segment; stressed segments are measured and reported but never counted toward continuity.

crossCheckDetail.note: Each pair is one video frame measured twice: on the main thread with an independent 64x48 readback, and in the worker on the pixels the pipeline actually delivered. The readback costs what §H.1 measured, which is why it runs at 1 Hz and is excluded from the pipeline UI cost in FRAME-005.

pipeline.note: Frames declined by rate pacing (pacedOut) are the scheduler working as designed and are not drops. Frames declined because the worker was busy (backpressured) are deliberate too. Only `lost` counts frames that were handed over and never came back, and only that is held against FRAME-001.
